final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The wrapper now decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before calling `vendor/slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`. The vendored `slugify` only keeps `a-z0-9`, so it drops accented letters before any fix in the wrapper can see them, which is why the change had to go in our code.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs still drop accents. I left it alone because you asked for the blog fix only. If you want product URLs fixed too, the same normalization can be applied there. A permanent fix in the vendored library would have to come from the platform team.
